'''Silica''' was a substance found in the soils of thousands of [[Planet/Legends|planets]].

The [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] would destroy planetary environments by [[Orbit/Legends|orbitally]] bombarding the surface originally composed of soil. The silica in the soil would be fused into [[Glass/Legends|glass]], which then broke up over time into sand. In the case of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] this was done and it boiled its [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]] away.

Silica was sometimes used as a material in structure walls. [[Mynock/Legends|Mynocks]] were known to eat this silica.
